title: Bigger (and readable) image size in ImageColumn
body:
`st.column_config.ImageColumn` includes a `width` parameter that controls the column width, but the image size inside the column stays the same - tiny and unreadable. You should fill the column with the image, such that increasing the width makes the images bigger and more readable.
Thanks!

comments.author: participant3
comments.body: @reporter There are a lot of limitations in rendering directly to html. st.dataframe has a lot of underlying optimizations that allow rendering large datasets. When you try to render large dataframes as html it is passed as string through websocket which can only take strings of certain size as the hard limit is set by [google's v8 engine](https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/35973#issuecomment-722265686).

comments.author: participant6
comments.body:
We will ship support for configuring row height in `st.dataframe` and `st.data_editor` in the 1.43 release. This can be configured via the `row_height` parameter:

```python
st.dataframe(df, row_height=100)
```
